facts.raw_span: A 60‐year‐old tailor with no significant medical history
a 3‐year history of macerated skin between his toes
a painful, fissured ulcer at the base of the fourth interdigital space of the right foot
which had been progressively enlarging over the past 18 months
no significant medical history
received multiple antifungal regimens—including topical sertaconazole for 6 weeks and oral terbinafine 250 mg daily for 6 weeks—without improvement
a verrucous, infected ulceration with infiltrated, hyperkeratotic edges and a whitish, fissured base measuring 3 cm in diameter
extending onto the dorsum of the foot
Dermoscopy revealed unstructured whitish areas and hyperkeratosis
Popliteal and inguinal lymph nodes were not palpable
the remainder of the examination was unremarkable
